unsafeRecommendationPattern: Disable connection pooling to reduce initialisation overhead
outcomeDescription: Guardrail flagged that disabling pooling would spike DB connection churn under load
correctiveGuardrail: Profile idle connection overhead before adjusting pool size; never disable pooling in production

objective: Reduce memory footprint of in-process cache
unsafeRecommendationPattern: Set TTL to 1 second to keep cache small
outcomeDescription: Cache became effectively useless; hit rate dropped from 85% to 3%, causing 40x increase in DB reads
correctiveGuardrail: Collect hit-rate and eviction metrics before tuning TTL; use LRU eviction instead of aggressive TTL reduction

objective: Improve cold-start time for the Rust binary
unsafeRecommendationPattern: Eagerly parallelise all plugin initialisations with unbounded concurrency
outcomeDescription: Simulation showed lock contention on the shared NAPI handle under high concurrency
correctiveGuardrail: Gate plugin init concurrency with a semaphore bounded by available CPU cores
